summary_text: In June 2026, the user placed three orders in the Chocolates category, all occurring in the morning. Two orders were placed on weekdays (June 12 and June 15) and one on a weekend (June 21). The user purchased Nestlé Milkybar products on all three dates, specifically the 22.5 g bar on June 12 and June 21, and the 80 g Choo Strawberry Flavour Treats Bar on June 15. While the specific product variant changed, the brand Nestlé Milkybar and the morning daypart appeared consistently across all independent dates.

The user purchased the Nestlé Milkybar 22.5 g bar on two independent dates in June 2026 (June 12 and June 21).
